I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread. I couldn't confirm the Bay 24 claim, so it's still unverified. I checked the channels Hollis belongs to and the public files, and none of them mention an Osprey rollout or Bay 24 at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

Quarrendon Freight Lines is a North team account, owned by Dana Okafor. I told Hollis to check the site with Dana or Ilse Varga, the North team lead, before anyone relies on it. I didn't look in the North team channels or the QFL incident channel because Hollis isn't a member of them.
